# Commercial Lending Solutions (CLS CRE)

> Commercial mortgage brokerage based in Los Angeles, California. Founded by Trevor Damyan. Over $1B in aggregate closed loan volume across 50 states, working with 1,000+ banks, debt funds, life insurance companies, state HFAs, CDFIs, and agency lenders (Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac). California DRE License #02244836. BBB-accredited business. Active member of the Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA), Urban Land Institute (ULI), NAIOP Commercial Real Estate Development Association, and ICSC (International Council of Shopping Centers).

> Specialties: ground-up multifamily construction, affordable housing capital stacks (Executive Directive 1 / EDI / ED1, 4% and 9% LIHTC, tax-exempt bond financing, non-profit GP welfare exemption structures), industrial and logistics, bridge and transitional debt, SBA 504 and 7(a), net lease, specialty property types.

> Content on this site is written by Trevor Damyan. All case studies anonymize borrower identity, describe lenders by type only, and use city-level geography. Statistics on per-deal volume, lender counts, and state coverage refer to CLS CRE aggregate career volume unless otherwise noted.

## Cornerstone pages

- [Homepage](https://clscre.com/index.html): Overview of CLS CRE, live market rate snapshot, featured transactions, financing programs
- [About](https://clscre.com/about.html): Broker profile, firm history, credentials, affiliations (BBB, MBA, ULI, NAIOP, ICSC)
- [Memberships and Affiliations](https://clscre.com/about.html#memberships): Details on BBB accreditation and membership in the Mortgage Bankers Association, Urban Land Institute, NAIOP, and ICSC
- [Affordable Housing & EDI Hub](https://clscre.com/affordable-housing/index.html): Topic hub for ground-up affordable multifamily, EDI / ED1, LIHTC, tax-exempt bonds, non-profit GP structures, California gap financing programs
- [Industrial CRE Hub](https://clscre.com/industrial/index.html): Topic hub for distribution/logistics warehouse, cold storage, data centers, manufacturing, industrial outdoor storage (IOS), flex industrial, build-to-suit
- [Multifamily CRE Hub](https://clscre.com/multifamily/index.html): Topic hub for agency (Fannie Mae DUS, Freddie Mac Optigo), CMBS, value-add bridge, ground-up construction, BTR, workforce, multifamily refinance strategy
- [Commercial CRE Hub](https://clscre.com/commercial/index.html): Topic hub for office, medical office, retail, net lease (NNN), mixed-use, self-storage, hospitality financing

## Affordable housing & EDI content

- [EDI / ED1 Explained: Ground-Up Affordable Financing in Los Angeles (2026)](https://clscre.com/blog/edi-ed1-ground-up-affordable-financing-los-angeles-2026.html): Cornerstone guide to LA Executive Directive 1 eligibility, incentives, capital stack, timelines, and lender sourcing for 100% affordable ground-up multifamily
- [The Non-Profit GP Strategy: Welfare Exemption, Tax-Exempt Status, and Capital Stacks](https://clscre.com/blog/nonprofit-gp-welfare-exemption-affordable-housing-capital-stack.html): How California welfare exemption (R&T §214) works, how for-profit developers partner with 501(c)(3) GPs, and how lenders credit the property tax savings in DSCR analysis
- [4% vs 9% LIHTC: Which Does Your Deal Need?](https://clscre.com/blog/4-vs-9-lihtc-which-does-your-deal-need.html): Practical decision framework for choosing between competitive 9% and bond-financed 4% Low-Income Housing Tax Credits
- [Affordable Housing Development in Los Angeles](https://clscre.com/blog/affordable-housing-developers-los-angeles.html): Market guide covering LAHD funding, entitlement bonuses, prevailing wage, AMI tiers, per-unit development costs
- [LIHTC Tax Credit Financing Explained](https://clscre.com/blog/lihtc-tax-credit-financing-explained.html): Educational primer on 4% and 9% LIHTC mechanics, syndicator dynamics, investor pricing, compliance periods
- [Ground-Up Multifamily Construction in Los Angeles (2026)](https://clscre.com/blog/ground-up-multifamily-construction-los-angeles-2026.html): Construction costs, rate environment, entitlement timelines, density bonuses, streamlining pathways for LA multifamily development
- [Affordable Housing Construction Financing California 2026](https://clscre.com/blog/affordable-housing-construction-financing-california-2026.html): Overview of California affordable housing construction financing sources and structures
- [AB 2011 Financing Guide: Office-to-Housing Conversions](https://clscre.com/blog/ab-2011-financing-guide-office-to-housing-conversion.html): How AB 2011 opens commercial parcels for ministerial housing approval statewide, and what the capital stack looks like for conversions
- [HHAP, NPLH, AHSC, MHP: California's Affordable Housing Capital Stack Decoded](https://clscre.com/blog/california-affordable-housing-capital-stack-hhap-nplh-ahsc-mhp-decoded.html): Field guide to the four state soft-debt programs most California affordable deals need, with stacking strategy and allocation-round timing
- [Construction-to-Permanent Conversion for LIHTC Deals](https://clscre.com/blog/construction-to-permanent-conversion-lihtc-deals.html): Structuring the perm take-out on LIHTC deals, sequencing, lender types, and common execution failures
- [HUD/FHA for Affordable and Workforce Multifamily: 221(d)(4), 223(f), 220](https://clscre.com/blog/hud-fha-affordable-workforce-multifamily-221d4-223f-220.html): Three HUD/FHA multifamily programs, when each fits, timelines, MAP lender ecosystem
- [Community Benefits Agreements and Mission-Aligned Capital](https://clscre.com/blog/community-benefits-agreements-mission-aligned-capital.html): How CBAs shape affordable deal economics and which mission-driven capital sources underwrite them favorably
- [CDFIs and Mission Banks: The Underused Affordable Housing Lender Universe](https://clscre.com/blog/cdfis-mission-banks-affordable-housing-lender-universe.html): CDFI and mission-bank lenders that close affordable deals mainstream banks won't, with positioning guidance
- [Land Trust Partnerships and Ground Leases](https://clscre.com/blog/land-trust-partnerships-ground-leases-nonprofit-developers.html): Community land trust and ground-lease affordable housing structures, lender reception, and capital stack implications
